availability_policy: Offline CGM observation-time availability assumption; actual scan/receipt absent. Meal experiment additionally assumes annotation known by source event time; not verified live ingestion.
static_policy: Stable demographic metadata supplied at onboarding; no BMI, labs, hypoglycemia summaries or medication features with uncertain timing
meal_subset: Source-annotated most recent meal at or before landmark and within 180 minutes; no nutrient fabrication
spike_preference: incident_two_readings_gt180 unless development-only evidence finds unusable prevalence; no arbitrary performance GO threshold
calibration_method: Logistic Platt mapping, C=1; four participant folds in reserved calibration cohort
risk_method_selection: Calibration participant-macro Brier; AUPRC reported, no headline accuracy
spike_decision_threshold: Maximize development calibration balanced accuracy on cross-fitted probabilities; ties prefer higher specificity
forecast_selection: Subject-macro equal-horizon MAE, cold and warm matched comparisons, then 120m MAE/fold consistency/rising errors/complexity; no holdout inspection
